engine.notes: Miami improv is two theaters, Just The Funny and Villain, with the Broward side adding New River, This Is Improv and the Broward Center's courses. Spanish-language improv is a real strand here (Just The Funny's Dale Impro and Impro en espanol; La Impro Machine runs workshops but has no site of its own). Laughing Gas, South Florida's 1992 troupe, keeps a site with no current schedule; Short Round I

entries.name: Just The Funny
entries.summary: Miami's longest-running improv theater and training center, since 1999, in a black-box room on Coral Way: improv every Friday and Saturday, a monthly improvised musical, Spanish-language improv and six-week improv, sketch and stand-up class
entries.schedule: Friday Night Live Fri 9pm; The Big Show Sat 9pm; Deathmatch first Fridays; Cheap Trills last Saturdays; Improv 1 six wee
signals: Impro en espanol classes and Dale Impro show
Home of the Miami Improv Festival
entries.reasons: Twenty-seven years in its own room with two weekly house shows, a festival and a class ladder; the class page still carried spring dates at the time of reading, which costs it on currency.

entries.name: Villain Theater
entries.summary: A 5,000-square-foot comedy theater and training center on NE 2nd Avenue, teaching since 2015, with improv shows every Tuesday and Saturday, a company of 60-plus improvisers, and a three-level improv track plus sketch and stand-up writing.
entries.schedule: Improv Tue 8:30pm and Sat 8:30pm; VT-1 starts Oct 14 and Nov 11 2026, VT-2 Nov 12, VT-3 Nov 18 2026 ($400)
signals: 5,000 sq ft with stage, classrooms and film studio
Calls itself the largest improv training center in Florida
entries.reasons: A decade in a large space of its own, two weekly improv nights, a dated class calendar and a sizeable company; it trails Just The Funny only on years and on a two-show rather than a deeper weekend bill.

entries.name: This Is Improv
entries.summary: A Broward County improv school and performance company, mostly at the Davie Woman's Club, with eight-week adult courses, kids' and teens' programmes, camps, a recurring Comedy Improv Jam and regular shows.
entries.schedule: Comedy Improv Jam Oct 2 2026 8pm; shows Sep 24 and Oct 8 2026; kids showcases Oct 6 and Oct 8 2026
entries.reasons: A current calendar with classes for every age, a jam and shows, held back by rented halls and a young, modest footprint.

entries.name: New River Theater
entries.summary: Fort Lauderdale's improv theater, founded by improviser and stand-up Josh Malina, running Level 1 and Level 2 intensives, Saturday morning drop-in classes and graduate showcases.
entries.schedule: Level 2 Mondays from Oct 26 2026, Level 1 Wednesdays from Oct 28 2026 ($195); drop-in Sat 10:30am $15
signals: Founder teaches at other South Florida theaters
entries.reasons: Dated autumn 2026 intensives and a weekly drop-in make it real, but it is new, small and shows are showcases rather than a house night.

entries.name: Broward Center for the Performing Arts (Adult Comedy Improv)
entries.summary: The performing-arts center's education department runs levelled adult comedy improv courses each term, from short-form games to a Level 3 class in long form that ends in a performance for friends and family.
entries.schedule: Level 2 Wednesdays Sep 9-Nov 18 2026 ($245); Level 3 Mondays Sep 14-Nov 30 2026 ($275)
signals: Term dates published with the year
entries.reasons: A stable institution with dated, levelled courses, but improv is one subject in a wide catalogue and there are no public shows or jams.
